offer.h: Get the paperwork into one place
offer.p: Four documents, one locator page, two printed pages.
items: A line to start the conversation

faq.a: No. It is a checklist. General education, not legal advice. Rules differ by state and country, so for anything beyond the basics speak to a qualified attorney or estate planner.
Filling in the checklist and locator is a sitting. Getting the documents themselves done takes longer, which is why each has its own done box.
Any adult. It is most useful if you have dependants, shared accounts or retirement accounts and policies with beneficiaries.

faq.q: Should I write passwords on it?
faq.a: No. Write where the details are kept, such as a password manager or a sealed envelope, and who knows.

faq.q: Can I use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes. It is a PDF, so any PDF app works. It also prints on US Letter or on A4 at fit to page.

faq.q: Does it include templates for a will?
faq.a: No. It lists what you need and tracks it. It does not provide legal documents.
